page.overview:
Who is Bastinado Garrotta?

Not to be confused with Bastinardo of Tilea.

Bastinado Garrotta is a notorious mercenary leader of a unit of Tilean crossbowmen.

Bastinado Garrotta's surname is inspired by the [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Garrote garrote], a weapon and a method of capital punishment that consists of a handheld ligature of chain, rope, scarf, wire or fishing line that is then used to strangle a person.
